title: Raw proper forget-supports compositor with explicit composite properness
statement: For proper p and f and an explicit properness instance for p;f, the raw canonical-composite forget-supports compositor calculation holds.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction: identify the properness instance for the canonical composite in the raw compositor calculation

proof.text: Identify the explicit proof of IsProper (p ≫ f) with IsProper.instCompScheme p f by Subsingleton.elim, and eliminate that equality. Obtain the raw compositor equation. Use congruence and heterogeneous proof irrelevance to identify its category-structure proof arguments with the original statement context, and transport the raw equation along the resulting equality of propositions.

proof_origin.place: First triangle, raw compositor calculation with explicit composite properness
proof_origin.why: Repair of the returned Y2 delivery against S4/ProperShriekCompSupportsRaw: the raw theorem now captures DerivedCategoryModule._proof_1 and _proof_2. A private kernel-checked congruence proof transports between these and the original instance proofs without unfolding derived functors or changing the public statement context. Composite properness is normalized explicitly. No new mathematical statement or sorry is introduced.
